title: Project Atlas Overview
body_markdown:
Project Atlas is Northwind Logistics' initiative to expand its delivery network into Portugal, starting with a Lisbon hub in Q1 2027.
## Goals
- Open a Lisbon distribution hub by March 2027
- Win 15 regional retail customers in the first six months
- Reach 94 percent on-time delivery within 90 days of launch
## Core team
- **Joe Smith** — Project Lead
- **Maria Lopez** — Finance and budgeting
- **Priya Natarajan** — Engineering and route optimization
- **Daniel Okafor** — Sales and customer partnerships
## Key search terms
Project Atlas, Lisbon hub, Northwind Logistics, market expansion.
